claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target (no auxiliary powers), proof.md's algorithm (section 1, field-map.md, the GT core of proof.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns x from T=[x]P0 via z=e(T,Q0)=g^x, g=e(P0,Q0), with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT, and all classical work is at most 2^119.032983238788 batched affine G1 additions (C=2,000 instructions): 10 x (core meter 2^115.7110551439 + wrapper 2^66, in core units of 20,000 instructions). Analytic exploratory claim. Class-number coprimality and h_K=1 are established in class-number.md; other assumptions remain. DESCENT.md justifies the unchanged valuation bound.
